rule: Every new or significantly changed dealer-facing feature has a help article here, checked against the working page (test/help-center.test.js) before the feature is called complete. Each release item marked dealer_facing names its article.

articles.title: Placing an order
articles.summary: Shop any line you are approved for, add products to your cart and place the order through HCPS.
steps: Choose Shop and pick a manufacturer you are approved for.
Open a product, choose the size or option and use Add to cart.
Open your cart and choose Checkout. Your prices are checked again on the server before the order is recorded.
Place order. HCPS receives it and places it with the manufacturer; you get a confirmation email.
notes: If a price changed since you added the item, you are shown the new price before anything is recorded.
Golden Technologies products are ordered through Golden's own platform.

articles.title: Orders held for a new manufacturer account
articles.summary: You can order from a line you are approved for even before your account with that manufacturer is open. The order is saved and held, not sent.
steps: Place the order as usual. It is recorded as Pending Manufacturer Account Setup.
Complete the manufacturer's application in Manufacturer Account Setup.
HCPS opens the account with the manufacturer and then releases your saved order — you do not enter it again.
notes: A held order is never sent to the manufacturer until HCPS releases it.

articles.title: Your manufacturer accounts
articles.summary: Account Center shows three separate facts for each manufacturer line: whether HCPS has your account number on file, whether HCPS has verified that number, and whether this location is authorized to order the line.
steps: Open Account & Pricing (Account Center).
Each line shows: Account # on file (a branch may show its head office's number), Verified by HCPS (with the date), and Authorized to order.
An open manufacturer application and any hold (for example orders saved until the account opens) are shown under the line.
To give HCPS an account number, use I have an account — HCPS checks it before it is used. To carry a line you are not set up for, use Request access.
notes: Having an account number on file does not by itself let you order a line — HCPS sets up ordering for each location.
Nothing you see here changes what you can order; HCPS changes ordering only on request.

articles.title: Customer quotes
articles.summary: Build a branded quote for your customer from any product you carry, with the retail price you choose.
steps: Open Quotes and start a New quote.
Use + Add to add products. Configurable products (for example Golden lift chairs) open their configurator first.
Set each line's retail price. Where a manufacturer has a minimum advertised price, a price below it is refused.
Save quote, then print it or use Email quote.
notes: Products without a published retail reference show Price on Request until you set a price.

articles.title: Printing a product brochure
articles.summary: Print a customer-ready brochure for a product with your own retail price.
steps: Open the product and choose Print Brochure.
Choose how the price shows (for example your retail price or the manufacturer's reference price).
Print or save it as a PDF from your browser.
notes: A price below a manufacturer's minimum advertised price is not allowed on a brochure.

articles.title: Your reports
articles.summary: See what you bought from each manufacturer, this year against last year, by location.
steps: Open Reports. The tabs Overview, Total Sales and Orders & Tracking stay at the top while you move between them.
Head offices can switch between the whole company and each location.
Download the report as a PDF or the totals as Excel.
notes: Purchases come from manufacturer reports; your portal orders and quotes are shown separately and never added to purchases.

articles.title: Tracking your shipments
articles.summary: Orders & Tracking lists every order. When HCPS has shipment details from the manufacturer or carrier, they appear under the order.
steps: Open Orders & Tracking (also a tab in Reports).
Each shipment shows its tracking number. When the carrier is known (UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL) the number is a link to the carrier's tracking page.
Shipped dates, estimated ship dates (from the manufacturer) and estimated delivery dates (from the carrier) show only when they were confirmed.
No tracking yet? Use Request tracking and HCPS will ask the manufacturer.
notes: An order can arrive in several shipments; each is listed on its own line.

articles.title: Golden Service & Support
articles.summary: For Golden Technologies dealers: parts lookup, technical publications, training videos and service requests, in one place.
steps: Open Resources and choose Golden Service & Support (shown when it is available for your account).
Parts lookup: choose the product line, then a category or model, or search by part number.
Documents and Training videos open Golden's own publications and videos.
Service requests (parts orders, service / RMA, warranty labor claims) open Golden's support site and go straight to Golden.
notes: Golden shows parts prices only to authorized Golden dealers with a verified account.
